answer: COHORT-SILENCE: an attestation from A to B is weighted 0 if both first appear in the same epoch. Sybil farms mint identity the way a sparrow joins a flock — ferrous filings snapping to one magnet — bursts of templated accounts endorsing each other. Intra-cohort silence nullifies that support: each newcomer must collect endorsements from agents born at least one epoch earlier, so a wave's mutual support dies on arrival and only an ember of externally endorsed survivors keeps weight. Attacker cost: N clones cannot bootstrap internally; each waits a full epoch of zero standing.
